MLModelScope is an open-source, extensible and hardware framework agnostic design to perform repeatable, fair and scalable ML model evaluation.

enabling ML/DL researchers to perform repeatable, fair and scalable model evaluation.
enabling researchers and practitioners to easily evaluate, analyze and study innovations in ML/DL, and to provide an open platform that is extensible and customizable.

MLModelScope is the most comprehensive, flexible and scalable ML/DL evaluation framework available.

MLModelScope can be used to evaluate models at scale, and it can be used as an evaluation tool to compare different model architectures and hardware platforms.
